items.text: In local government, scrapped climate targets in seven of the nine councils it leads, rescinded declarations of a climate emergency in three, and in one called human-caused climate change unproven.

Pledged to scrap the national net zero target and the subsidies for wind and solar power, and its deputy leader said it would strike down guaranteed-price contracts for new wind and solar power awarded in the government's next auction, before saying hours later that a legally binding contract would stand.
Pledged to reverse on its first day in government the ban on new oil and gas drilling at sea, with the government taking a stake in new projects.
